title: Team behind smart Salem launch innovative DNA driven longevity platform
summary: The flagship package in the new service line is the Dubai It package, covering over 1000 health and DNA data points
thbAction: Pitch THB's diagnostics CRM to help labs manage doctor outreach, collection-center expansion, and B2B referral relationships while improving conversion and retention.
contentHtml:
The flagship package in the new service line is the Dubai It package, covering over 1000 health and DNA data points

Press Release

The pioneering team behind Dubai’s premium visa medical testing centers Smart Salem have entered the longevity sector, launching a diverse range of cutting-edge preventative health and longevity services in the UAE, under new brand Klea Health.

Smart Salem was inaugurated in 2020 in line with the vision of Dubai D33 to make Dubai an innovative, smart city by utilizing advanced robotics, automation and technology to provide the mandatory visa medical test as efficiently as possible.

In 2024 the company, owned by French firm Klea Holding, diversified into wellness and longevity services in response to growing demand from customers and aligned with its purpose to empower people to live better, healthier and longer lives. The success of these services led to the decision to create a dedicated longevity venture, Klea Health. 

The team is also announcing the launch of its flagship health and longevity package, the Dubai It package which assesses over 1000 individual health data points across both comprehensive real-time biomarkers and in-depth DNA insights, including cancer risk screening, genetic predispositions & ancestry, gut, heart and hormonal health, and even longevity biomarkers for optimizing cellular ageing. The package retails at 10,000AED (worth over 15,000AED) and is already proving to be a favorite with customers, as the second most popular package sold since launch.

CEO Amanda Gravitis said, “Through the launch of Klea Health we are doubling down on our commitment to deliver world-leading preventative health and longevity services to the UAE and strategically positioning ourselves for growth. The UAE is rapidly evolving as a global wellness and longevity hub, reflecting the growing understanding of the importance of preventative health and backed by a clear vision from the Dubai Government who have just recently launched a new Longevity Authority to help regulate and drive the industry. The success we have had since our launch only two weeks ago tells me we have got this right – people want to understand their health better so they can live healthier for longer and they are willing to invest in it.”

Klea Health’s diverse range of advanced preventative health packages – from cancer risk screening, heart and gut health to longevity and DNA services - is built around their bespoke Longevity Protocol, which focuses on four key elements:

1. Comprehensive biomarker analysis. Establishing a health baseline through comprehensive biomarker analysis to identify imbalances early and track changes over time. 

2. In-depth DNA insights. Combining this information with in-depth DNA insights to understand genetic predispositions, risks and treatment efficacy and provide a unique 360 health overview.

3. Advanced technology. Utilising the latest technologies to ensure accurate testing and a fast, seamless digital experience. 

4. Personalised, practical and actionable insights. Providing highly personalised, actionable insights to enable people to make informed decisions and truly take ownership of their health.

Commenting on the market, Amanda added, “Despite the recent challenges the region has seen, we are confident that the UAE market is recovering and will continue to grow, due in no small part to the prompt and decisive action from the Government following the conflict. The positioning of healthcare as a strategic growth industry combined with growing demand from more health-aware customers and the shift in approach from treatment to preventative health globally give me huge confidence for the future. There is no better time or market to be launching Klea Health into and we are very excited to see how it evolves."

Klea Health is offering a special launch deal - 20% off all core and specialised screenings, DNA packages and select comprehensive packages (All of You and Essentials packages) until 31st December 2026. Customers can use code KLEA20 online or in person at any of the Klea Health centers.
